title: RAST: Resolution-Aware Privileged Structure Transfer for Low-Resolution Audio Activity Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2609.38780v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audio is increasingly used for human activity recognition (HAR) because it captures object interactions, environmental events, and contextual cues in everyday environments. High-resolution (HR) audio provides rich acoustic information for model development but incurs substantial energy and storage costs and may expose sensitive speech content. Low-resolution (LR) audio offers a more privacy-preserving and resource-efficient alternative for deployment, but reduced sampling rates can remove acoustic cues essential for activity recognition, leading to significant performance degradation. We formulate this training-deployment mismatch as sensor-resolution privileged learning, in which HR audio is available during training, while inference relies exclusively on LR audio. translated_title: RAST：面向低分辨率音频活动识别的分辨率感知特权结构迁移
translated_abstract: 音频因能够捕捉物体交互、环境事件以及日常环境中的情境线索，在人体活动识别（HAR）中的应用日益广泛。高分辨率（HR）音频为模型开发提供了丰富的声学信息，但会带来巨大的能耗和存储成本，并可能暴露敏感的语音内容。低分辨率（LR）音频为实际部署提供了一种更保护隐私、更节省资源的替代方案，但采样率的降低会丢失对活动识别至关重要的声学线索，导致性能显著下降。我们将这种训练与部署之间的不匹配问题形式化为“传感器分辨率特权学习”，即训练阶段可以使用高分辨率音频，而推理阶段仅依赖低分辨率音频。我们提出了RAST，一种分辨率感知的迁移框架，它通过在压缩高分辨率教师表示之前保留token级信息和邻域结构……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RAST框架，将训练-部署间的传感器分辨率不匹配形式化为特权学习问题，通过在压缩高分辨率音频教师表示时保留token级信息与邻域结构，将其迁移至低分辨率音频学生模型，从而在保护隐私和节省资源的同时提升低分辨率音频人体活动识别的性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RAST, a resolution-aware privileged transfer framework that preserves token-level information and neighborhood structure when compressing high-resolution audio teacher representations, enabling accurate human activity recognition using only privacy-preserving, resource-efficient low-resolution audio at inference time.
